vocab.sentence: Mom was cooking chicken when I got home.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我到家時，媽媽正在煮雞肉。

vocab.sentence: An ant was walking along the wall then.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 一隻螞蟻當時正沿著牆壁走。

vocab.sentence: The ugly duck was swimming when we arrived.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們到達時，那隻醜陋的鴨子正在游泳。

vocab.sentence: The duck was looking for food at seven.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 那隻鴨子七點時正在找食物。

vocab.sentence: A goose was resting beside the pool then.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 一隻鵝當時正在水池邊休息。

vocab.sentence: The frog jumped away when the boy shouted.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 男孩大叫時，青蛙跳走了。

vocab.sentence: The cow was eating grass when we passed.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們經過時，那頭母牛正在吃草。

vocab.sentence: We checked the map before we entered the forest.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們進入森林前先查看地圖。

vocab.sentence: At the beginning of the game, we were losing.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 比賽剛開始時，我們處於落後。

vocab.sentence: The boy was standing in the middle then.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 那個男孩當時正站在中間。

vocab.sentence: We finished lunch at a quarter past twelve.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們在十二點十五分吃完午餐。

vocab.sentence: We were walking along the river at five.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 五點時，我們正沿著河邊走。

vocab.sentence: The sky was clear when we left home.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們離家時，天空很晴朗。

vocab.sentence: We saw a goose when we passed the farm.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們經過農場時，看見一隻鵝。

vocab.sentence: They were walking in the forest at noon.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 中午時，他們正在森林裡走路。

vocab.sentence: I dried my hands before I picked up the map.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我拿起地圖前先擦乾雙手。

vocab.sentence: I heard something when I opened the door.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我開門時，聽到了什麼聲音。

vocab.sentence: She was putting water into a jar then.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 她當時正在把水倒進罐子裡。

vocab.sentence: The duck opened its beak when it saw food.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 鴨子看見食物時張開了嘴。

vocab.sentence: We reached the pool before the rain started.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們在開始下雨前到達水池。

vocab.sentence: The frog was sitting on a rock then.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 那隻青蛙當時正坐在岩石上。

vocab.sentence: A bird flew past when I looked up.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我抬頭時，一隻鳥飛了過去。

vocab.sentence: I picked up the map after it fell.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 地圖掉下來後，我把它撿起來。

vocab.sentence: We came back after we finished the game.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們比賽結束後就回來了。

vocab.sentence: The girl dropped her jar when she fell.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 女孩跌倒時，手裡的罐子掉了。

vocab.sentence: The frog jumped into the pool when we shouted.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們大叫時，青蛙跳進水池。

vocab.sentence: The teacher said, "Good job!" after we finished.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們完成後，老師說：「做得好！」

vocab.sentence: Mom was proud of me when I won.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我獲勝時，媽媽以我為榮。

vocab.sentence: The cow was walking back and forth then.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 那頭母牛當時正在來回走動。

vocab.sentence: We finally found water after we crossed the forest.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們穿過森林後，終於找到了水。

vocab.sentence: We reached the top before the sun went down.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們在太陽下山前到達頂端。

vocab.sentence: The bus went past when I opened the door.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我開門時，公車經過了。

vocab.sentence: I finished my homework before I watched TV.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我看電視前先做完功課。

vocab.sentence: Did you eat anything before you went out?
vocab.sentence_chinese: 你出門前有吃任何東西嗎？

vocab.sentence: The children shouted when they saw the snake.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 孩子們看見蛇時大叫。

vocab.sentence: The players shouted for joy after they won.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 選手們獲勝後高興地大叫。

vocab.sentence: We were swimming in the pool at three.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 三點時，我們正在游泳池游泳。

vocab.sentence: The phone rang when I was taking a break.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我正在休息時，電話響了。

vocab.sentence: The goose came close when I held out food.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我伸出手拿著食物時，鵝靠了過來。

phrases.sentence: We sat in the sun and enjoyed the warm weather.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 我們坐在太陽下，享受溫暖的天氣。

phrases.sentence: Let's take a break and rest for a few minutes.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 我們休息一下，休息幾分鐘吧。

phrases.sentence: Just wait and see; everything will work out in time.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 就等著瞧吧；一切終會順利解決。

phrases.sentence: Dad bent down to pick up the ball from the ground.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 爸爸彎下腰撿起地上的球。

phrases.sentence: You led the team well. Good job!
phrases.sentence_chinese: 你把團隊帶領得很好。做得好！

phrases.sentence: We're proud of our country's rich culture and history.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 我們以國家的豐富文化和歷史為榮。

phrases.sentence: The children ran back and forth across the playground.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 孩子們在操場上來回奔跑。

tips.label: 事件的先後
tips.text: A before B：A 先、B 後；A after B：B 先、A 後。先找時間或 First／Then 的線索。

tips.label: 當……的時候
tips.text: When + 子句放句首，後面加逗號；放句尾通常不用逗號。動詞時態要看情境。

tips.label: 過去正在做
tips.text: 主詞 + was／were + V-ing。I／he／she／it 用 was；you／we／they 用 were。

tips.label: 問當時的活動
tips.text: What was／were + 主詞 + doing? 回答保留 was／were + V-ing；Yes／No 簡答保留 was／were。

tips.label: 正在做時發生另一件事
tips.text: We were walking when it started to rain. 正在走路是背景，開始下雨是其間發生的事件。

tips.label: 時間的逆讀
tips.text: 4:20 = twenty past four；4:50 = ten to five；4:15 = a quarter past four；4:30 = half past four。

notes.title: 連接詞：連接、轉折、選擇與因果
notes.description: and 加上同類資訊；but 表示轉折；or 表示選擇。because 後接原因，so 後接結果；同一組因果關係不要同時用 because 和 so。
examples: The jar was empty, so we looked for water.（罐子空了，所以我們去找水。）
We took a break because we were tired.（我們因為累了而休息。）
The rock was small, but it was heavy.（那塊石頭很小，但很重。）

notes.title: when：時間子句與位置
notes.rule: When + 主詞 + 動詞, 主詞 + 動詞.／主詞 + 動詞 + when + 主詞 + 動詞.
notes.description: when 表示「當……時」，時間子句放句首後面加逗號。相同人物再次出現，可用代名詞，但要讓讀者清楚知道代名詞指誰。時態依事件判斷，不是一看到 when 就一律使用過去式。
examples: When the goose saw us, it came close.（那隻鵝看見我們時，就靠了過來。）
The goose came close when it saw us.（那隻鵝看見我們時，就靠了過來。）
When Mom cooks, she opens the window.（媽媽煮飯時會開窗。）

notes.title: before／after：先後順序不看句子位置
notes.rule: A before B = B after A
notes.description: before 後方的事件較晚發生；after 後方的事件較早發生。改寫時先畫出事件順序，不能只替換 before／after。鐘點、First、Then、finished 等線索能幫助判斷。
examples: We checked the map before we left.（我們離開前先看地圖。）
After we checked the map, we left.（我們看完地圖後就離開了。）
We left after we checked the map.（我們看完地圖後就離開了。）

notes.title: before／after 後接子句或 V-ing
notes.rule: before／after + 主詞 + 動詞；before／after + V-ing
notes.description: 接完整子句時，要有主詞和符合時態的動詞。兩個動作的主詞相同且意思清楚時，可以省略子句主詞，把動詞改成 V-ing；主詞不同時保留完整子句，避免誤解。
examples: After I filled the jar, I went back.（我裝滿罐子後就回去了。）
After filling the jar, I went back.（裝滿罐子後，我就回去了。）
I closed the gate before the cow came close.（母牛靠近前，我關上了門。）

notes.title: 時間子句搭配祈使句
notes.rule: When／Before／After + 現在式子句, 原形動詞 ...
notes.description: 主句提出要求或建議時，使用原形動詞。when／before／after 引導的時間子句表達將來的時間時，通常使用現在簡單式；第三人稱單數仍須注意動詞加 s。
examples: Please call me when the bus comes.（公車來時，請打電話給我。）
Before you enter the forest, check the map.（進入森林前，先查看地圖。）

notes.title: 過去進行式：肯定、否定與 V-ing
notes.description: 描述過去某個時間正在進行的活動。單數名詞與 I／he／she／it 用 was；複數名詞與 you／we／they 用 were。否定直接加 not，不用 did not + V-ing。常見變化：walk → walking、take → taking、run → running、drop → dropping、fly → flying。
examples: The goose was swimming at six yesterday.（那隻鵝昨天六點正在游泳。）
They were not playing at that time.（他們當時沒有在玩。）
The children were running back and forth.（孩子們當時正在來回跑。）

notes.title: 過去進行式：問句與簡答
notes.rule: Was／Were + 主詞 + V-ing...?；What + was／were + 主詞 + doing...?
notes.description: 問句將 was／were 放到主詞前。Yes／No 簡答保留 be；What ... doing 問的是當時在做什麼。問句的 you 在回答時可變成 I，was／were 要跟著主詞調整。
examples: Were you looking at the map? — Yes, I was.（你當時在看地圖嗎？——是的。）
Was the cow eating? — No, it was not.（母牛當時在吃東西嗎？——沒有。）
What were they doing? — They were picking up rocks.（他們當時在做什麼？——他們在撿石頭。）

notes.title: 過去進行式：並列與省略
notes.rule: was／were + V-ing and V-ing；重複活動可省略，保留 was／were
notes.description: 同一主詞同時進行兩個活動，可共用 was／were，但兩個動詞都要用 V-ing。前後重複的活動也可省略，保留與主詞一致的 was／were。
examples: The children were singing and dancing.（孩子們當時一邊唱歌一邊跳舞。）
I was swimming, and my friends were, too.（我當時在游泳，我的朋友們也一樣。）
Dad was cooking, but Mom was not.（爸爸當時在煮飯，但媽媽沒有。）

notes.title: 過去進行式搭配 when
notes.rule: 主詞 + was／were + V-ing + when + 主詞 + 過去式
notes.description: 背景活動在另一事件發生前已開始，而且在事件發生時仍持續，就用過去進行式。其間發生的事件用過去簡單式。when 也可以連接兩個過去簡單式事件，所以不能只靠 when 判定所有動詞的時態。
examples: We were crossing the forest when it started to rain.（開始下雨時，我們正在穿越森林。）
When the jar fell, Billy was looking at the map.（罐子掉下來時，Billy 正在看地圖。）
When I heard the shout, I opened the door.（我聽見喊叫時，就打開了門。）

notes.title: 時間：past／after、to、quarter 與 half
notes.rule: 分鐘 + past／after + 當下鐘點；剩餘分鐘 + to + 下一個鐘點
notes.description: 順讀先念鐘點，再念分鐘。逆讀時，1–30 分可用 past／after；超過 30 分可用 to，分鐘改成 60 減原分鐘，鐘點改成下一個鐘點。a quarter 是 15 分鐘，half past 是半點；不用 half to。時間點前用 at；時段用 in the morning／afternoon／evening。
examples: 2:20 = twenty past two / twenty after two
7:50 = ten to eight
3:15 = a quarter past three
6:45 = a quarter to seven
5:30 p.m. = half past five in the afternoon

quiz.question: There was no water left in our bottles, ___ we stopped to fill them.
quiz.hint: 水喝完是原因，停下來裝水是結果。so 後面接結果。

quiz.question: We stayed out of the pool ___ a storm was coming.
quiz.hint: 暴風雨快來了，說明大家為什麼沒下水。原因子句用 because 引導。

quiz.question: The little duck could swim well, ___ it still could not fly.
quiz.hint: 能游泳與還不會飛形成轉折，因此用 but。

quiz.question: We have time for just one activity. Should we swim ___ go for a walk?
quiz.hint: just one activity 表示只能選一個，兩個選項之間用 or。

quiz.question: The two children brought both water ___ food on the walk.
quiz.hint: both A and B 表示兩樣都有。用 and 並列 water 和 food。

quiz.question: Last Saturday, when the farmer opened the gate, the cows ___ out right away.
quiz.hint: Last Saturday 和 opened 指出是過去的事。主句的限定動詞用過去式 ran。

quiz.question: When the light ___ green, cross the street.
quiz.hint: cross the street 是指令，when 子句交代何時執行，用現在式。the light 是單數，因此用 turns。

quiz.question: We found the map at noon and started our walk at one. We found it ___ we started walking.
quiz.hint: 中午找到地圖，一點才開始走。找到地圖比開始走早，因此用 before。

quiz.question: The children fed the ducks at three. An hour later, they took a break. They took a break ___ they fed the ducks.
quiz.hint: 餵鴨後隔了一小時才休息，休息比餵鴨晚，因此用 after。

quiz.question: Before ___ water into the jar, wash it with soap.
quiz.hint: before 後省略了與祈使句相同的主詞 you，動詞用 pouring。

quiz.question: After ___ the rock with both hands, Maya set it on the table.
quiz.hint: 撿起和放下都是 Maya 做的。after 後省略主詞時，可用 picking up。

quiz.question: After Dad ___ the map yesterday, he knew which way to go.
quiz.hint: after 後已有主詞 Dad，須接限定動詞。yesterday 指過去，所以用 checked。

quiz.question: Before you touch the duck, ___ your hands.
quiz.hint: 逗號後是對 you 下指令的祈使句，句首動詞用原形 wash。

quiz.question: Please turn off the lights before you ___ the room tonight.
quiz.hint: tonight 指未來，但 before 引導時間子句時用現在式。you 搭配 leave。

quiz.question: As soon as the rain stopped, we went back outside. ___ the rain stopped, we went back outside.
quiz.hint: as soon as 表示雨一停就出去。when 可指出雨停的那一刻，because of 後不能接這個完整子句。

quiz.question: At seven last night, a frog ___ sitting on a flat rock by the pond.
quiz.hint: At seven last night 指過去，a frog 是單數，與 sitting 搭配的是 was。

quiz.question: When we passed the farm yesterday, the cows ___ eating grass by the fence.
quiz.hint: 昨天經過時，吃草正在進行。the cows 是複數，所以用 were eating。

quiz.question: At noon yesterday, I was asleep. I ___ looking for the map then.
quiz.hint: I was asleep 表示當時沒在找地圖。I 搭配 wasn't，再接 looking。

quiz.question: We were all inside when it started raining. We ___ swimming in the pool then.
quiz.hint: 大家都在屋內，當時沒有在泳池游泳。We 搭配 weren't，再接 swimming。

quiz.question: The duck was ___ across the pool when we got there.
quiz.hint: was 後接 V-ing 表示當時正在進行。swim 要重複 m 再加 ing。

quiz.question: At noon yesterday, the farmer was ___ a chicken back to the farm.
quiz.hint: was 後接 V-ing，take 去掉字尾 e 再加 ing。

quiz.question: At that moment, the birds were ___ over the forest.
quiz.hint: were 後接 V-ing 表示正在飛。fly 直接加 ing，寫成 flying。

quiz.question: At nine yesterday, I ___ looking through a box for the old map.
quiz.hint: at nine yesterday 指過去，主詞 I 搭配 was looking。

quiz.question: You ___ walking back and forth when I saw you yesterday.
quiz.hint: saw 和 yesterday 指過去。You 搭配 were walking。

quiz.question: The dog was running along the path and ___ at every bird it saw.
quiz.hint: 同一隻狗的兩個動作共用 was，running 與 barking 都用 V-ing。

quiz.question: Amy was drawing a frog, and her classmates ___, too.
quiz.hint: classmates 是複數，省略重複的 drawing a frog 後保留 were。

quiz.question: The children were running, but their grandfather ___. He was sitting under a tree.
quiz.hint: 後句表示祖父當時沒在跑。省略 running，單數主詞用 wasn't。

quiz.question: ___ the geese flying over the trees when you saw them?
quiz.hint: 過去進行式問句把 be 放句首。geese 是複數，用 Were。

quiz.question: ___ the cow standing near the gate when you got there?
quiz.hint: got there 指過去。the cow 是單數，過去進行式問句以 Was 開頭。

quiz.question: A: Were you both resting under the tree then? B: Yes, we ___.
quiz.hint: 問句是過去進行式，簡答保留過去式 be。回答主詞 we 搭配 were。

quiz.question: A: Was your brother carrying the map? B: No, he ___. I had it.
quiz.hint: Was 開頭的問句用 was 或 wasn't 簡答。No 指否定，he 搭配 wasn't。

quiz.question: A: Were you taking pictures of the ducks? B: Yes, I ___.
quiz.hint: 問句的 you 到回答變成 I。過去進行式簡答要保留 was。

quiz.question: What ___ the children doing in the middle of the field when you saw them?
quiz.hint: saw 指過去，children 是複數，用 What were ... doing?

quiz.question: What was the little frog ___ under the rock?
quiz.hint: was 已是限定動詞。問當時在做什麼，用 What was ... doing?

quiz.question: A: What was Grandpa doing at five yesterday? B: He ___ rocks from the path.
quiz.hint: 問句是過去進行式，he 搭配 was，再接 picking up。

quiz.question: I was halfway across the bridge when my map suddenly ___ into the river.
quiz.hint: 地圖突然掉落是過去某一刻發生的事件，使用過去簡單式 fell。

quiz.question: The teacher was still reading aloud when the bell ___.
quiz.hint: 老師還在朗讀是背景，鐘響是過去發生的事件。ring 的過去式是 rang。

quiz.question: When the jar broke, we ___ still looking for a place to put it.
quiz.hint: broke 指過去。we 搭配 were still looking，表示當時仍在找。

quiz.question: We heard a loud shout yesterday while we ___ walking along the river.
quiz.hint: 聽見喊叫時，沿河走正在進行。we 搭配 were walking。

quiz.question: The show was just starting when the lights suddenly ___ out.
quiz.hint: 表演正要開始時，燈突然熄滅。這個過去事件用 went out。

quiz.question: Lily ___ her hands when the doorbell rang. She still had soap on them when she opened the door.
quiz.hint: rang 和 opened 指過去，手上還有肥皂顯示鈴響時仍在洗手。Lily 搭配 was washing。

quiz.question: When the truck passed, the geese ___ crossing the road. They were only halfway across.
quiz.hint: halfway across 顯示牠們當時還在過馬路。geese 是複數，搭配 were still crossing。

quiz.question: The clock says 8:15. It's ___.
quiz.hint: 8:15 是八點過十五分。a quarter 是十五分鐘，因此用 a quarter past eight。

quiz.question: Our train leaves at 3:45. That's ___.
quiz.hint: 3:45 距離下一個整點四點還有十五分鐘，因此用 a quarter to four。

quiz.question: The show ended at 11:30, or ___.
quiz.hint: 11:30 是十一點半，因此用 half past eleven。

quiz.question: It's 2:50. That means it's ___.
quiz.hint: 2:50 距離三點還有十分鐘，因此用 ten to three。

quiz.question: The pool closes ___ twenty past six every evening.
quiz.hint: twenty past six 是明確的鐘點，前面加 at。

quiz.question: It's 9:05. It's five minutes ___ nine.
quiz.hint: 9:05 是九點過五分，five minutes after nine 表示這個鐘點。

quiz.question: Our class starts at 10:30. It starts in fifteen minutes. It's ___ now.
quiz.hint: 從 10:30 往前推十五分鐘是 10:15，因此用 a quarter past ten。

quiz.question: It's 12:55, so it's ___.
quiz.hint: 12:55 距離下一個整點一點只剩五分鐘，因此用 five to one。

vocab.sentence: Mom was cooking chicken when I got home.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我到家時，媽媽正在煮雞肉。

vocab.sentence: An ant was walking along the wall then.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 一隻螞蟻當時正沿著牆壁走。

vocab.sentence: The ugly duck was swimming when we arrived.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們到達時，那隻醜陋的鴨子正在游泳。

vocab.sentence: The duck was looking for food at seven.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 那隻鴨子七點時正在找食物。

vocab.sentence: A goose was resting beside the pool then.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 一隻鵝當時正在水池邊休息。

vocab.sentence: The frog jumped away when the boy shouted.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 男孩大叫時，青蛙跳走了。

vocab.sentence: The cow was eating grass when we passed.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們經過時，那頭母牛正在吃草。

vocab.sentence: We checked the map before we entered the forest.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們進入森林前先查看地圖。

vocab.sentence: At the beginning of the game, we were losing.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 比賽剛開始時，我們處於落後。

vocab.sentence: The boy was standing in the middle then.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 那個男孩當時正站在中間。

vocab.sentence: We finished lunch at a quarter past twelve.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們在十二點十五分吃完午餐。

vocab.sentence: We were walking along the river at five.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 五點時，我們正沿著河邊走。

vocab.sentence: The sky was clear when we left home.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們離家時，天空很晴朗。

vocab.sentence: We saw a goose when we passed the farm.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們經過農場時，看見一隻鵝。

vocab.sentence: They were walking in the forest at noon.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 中午時，他們正在森林裡走路。

vocab.sentence: I dried my hands before I picked up the map.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我拿起地圖前先擦乾雙手。

vocab.sentence: I heard something when I opened the door.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我開門時，聽到了什麼聲音。

vocab.sentence: She was putting water into a jar then.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 她當時正在把水倒進罐子裡。

vocab.sentence: The duck opened its beak when it saw food.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 鴨子看見食物時張開了嘴。

vocab.sentence: We reached the pool before the rain started.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們在開始下雨前到達水池。

vocab.sentence: The frog was sitting on a rock then.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 那隻青蛙當時正坐在岩石上。

vocab.sentence: A bird flew past when I looked up.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我抬頭時，一隻鳥飛了過去。

vocab.sentence: I picked up the map after it fell.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 地圖掉下來後，我把它撿起來。

vocab.sentence: We came back after we finished the game.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們比賽結束後就回來了。

vocab.sentence: The girl dropped her jar when she fell.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 女孩跌倒時，手裡的罐子掉了。

vocab.sentence: The frog jumped into the pool when we shouted.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們大叫時，青蛙跳進水池。

vocab.sentence: The teacher said, "Good job!" after we finished.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們完成後，老師說：「做得好！」

vocab.sentence: Mom was proud of me when I won.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我獲勝時，媽媽以我為榮。

vocab.sentence: The cow was walking back and forth then.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 那頭母牛當時正在來回走動。

vocab.sentence: We finally found water after we crossed the forest.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們穿過森林後，終於找到了水。

vocab.sentence: We reached the top before the sun went down.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們在太陽下山前到達頂端。

vocab.sentence: The bus went past when I opened the door.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我開門時，公車經過了。

vocab.sentence: I finished my homework before I watched TV.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我看電視前先做完功課。

vocab.sentence: Did you eat anything before you went out?
vocab.sentence_chinese: 你出門前有吃任何東西嗎？

vocab.sentence: The children shouted when they saw the snake.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 孩子們看見蛇時大叫。

vocab.sentence: The players shouted for joy after they won.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 選手們獲勝後高興地大叫。

vocab.sentence: We were swimming in the pool at three.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 三點時，我們正在游泳池游泳。

vocab.sentence: The phone rang when I was taking a break.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我正在休息時，電話響了。

vocab.sentence: The goose came close when I held out food.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我伸出手拿著食物時，鵝靠了過來。

phrases.sentence: We sat in the sun and enjoyed the warm weather.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 我們坐在太陽下，享受溫暖的天氣。

phrases.sentence: Let's take a break and rest for a few minutes.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 我們休息一下，休息幾分鐘吧。

phrases.sentence: Just wait and see; everything will work out in time.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 就等著瞧吧；一切終會順利解決。

phrases.sentence: Dad bent down to pick up the ball from the ground.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 爸爸彎下腰撿起地上的球。

phrases.sentence: You led the team well. Good job!
phrases.sentence_chinese: 你把團隊帶領得很好。做得好！

phrases.sentence: We're proud of our country's rich culture and history.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 我們以國家的豐富文化和歷史為榮。

phrases.sentence: The children ran back and forth across the playground.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 孩子們在操場上來回奔跑。

grammar.sentence: The water was cold, but we went swimming.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 水很冷，但我們還是下去游泳了。

grammar.sentence: Check the map before you cross the river.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 過河前先看一下地圖。

grammar.sentence: The children were washing their hands at noon.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 孩子們中午正在洗手。

grammar.sentence: The first bus leaves at a quarter to six.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 第一班公車五點四十五分發車。

grammar.sentence: I was feeding the ducks when the rain started.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 開始下雨時，我正在餵鴨子。

grammar.sentence: After drying the jar, Mia put it away.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 把罐子擦乾後，Mia 就把它收起來了。

grammar.sentence: We had no map, so we asked for help.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們沒有地圖，所以就請人幫忙。

grammar.sentence: What were the geese doing near the gate?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 那些鵝當時在大門附近做什麼？

grammar.sentence: The farmer came back at half past four.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 農夫四點半回來。

grammar.sentence: When the sun came out, the frogs jumped into the pool.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 太陽出來時，青蛙跳進了水池。

grammar.sentence: Before leaving home, Leo filled his water bottle.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 離家前，Leo 裝滿了水壺。

grammar.sentence: Were you cooking chicken when I called?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我打電話時，你正在煮雞肉嗎？

grammar.sentence: We stopped walking because the path was wet.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們停下腳步，因為小路濕了。

grammar.sentence: It was ten to eight when we reached school.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們到學校時是七點五十分。

grammar.sentence: The ducks were swimming and looking for food.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 那些鴨子一邊游泳一邊找食物。

grammar.sentence: After the show ended, we took some pictures.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 表演結束後，我們拍了幾張照片。

grammar.sentence: We were not sitting in the sun then.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們當時沒有坐在陽光下。

grammar.sentence: Call me when your bus reaches the station.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 你的公車到站時，打電話給我。

grammar.sentence: The race begins at twenty past three.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 比賽三點二十分開始。

grammar.sentence: Two ants were carrying food along the wall.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 兩隻螞蟻當時正沿著牆搬運食物。

grammar.sentence: I packed lunch before my brother woke up.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我在弟弟起床前就把午餐裝好了。

grammar.sentence: Would you like to walk or take the bus?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 你想走路還是搭公車？

grammar.sentence: When the door opened, we were making lunch.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 門打開時，我們正在做午餐。

grammar.sentence: After washing the dishes, Ben took a break.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 洗完碗後，Ben 休息了一下。

grammar.sentence: It is a quarter past nine right now.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 現在是九點十五分。

grammar.sentence: Was the duck hiding behind a rock then?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 那隻鴨子當時正躲在石頭後面嗎？

grammar.sentence: The kids were laughing when the teacher arrived.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 老師到的時候，孩子們正在笑。

grammar.sentence: I brought the map, and Nora brought the food.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我帶了地圖，Nora 帶了食物。

grammar.sentence: Please close the gate after the cows leave.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 母牛離開後，請把門關上。

grammar.sentence: Dad was sleeping, but the children were not.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 爸爸當時在睡覺，孩子們沒有。

cloze_quiz.question: We had ___ soup for lunch. The meat came from a hen.
cloze_quiz.hint: hen 是母雞，來自母雞的肉是 chicken（雞肉），不是鴨肉、牛肉或魚肉。

cloze_quiz.question: A tiny ___ with six legs was carrying food back to its nest.
cloze_quiz.hint: ant 是螞蟻；體型小、有六隻腳、搬食物回巢都是線索。蜘蛛有八隻腳。

cloze_quiz.question: I think the drawing looks ___. I don't find it beautiful at all.
cloze_quiz.hint: not beautiful 表示不好看；ugly 是醜陋的。dry 是乾的，clear 是清楚的，proud 是驕傲的。

cloze_quiz.question: The short-necked farm bird said "quack, quack." It was a ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: duck 是鴨子，quack 是鴨子的叫聲；goose 是鵝，cow 是母牛，frog 是青蛙。

cloze_quiz.question: One ___, two geese: these are the singular and plural forms.
cloze_quiz.hint: goose 是鵝，複數是不規則的 geese；題目要找 geese 對應的單數形式。

cloze_quiz.question: The green ___ jumped into the pond and made a loud croaking sound.
cloze_quiz.hint: frog 是青蛙；綠色、跳進池塘、發出呱呱聲是線索。

cloze_quiz.question: The farmer gets milk from this female farm animal. It is a ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: cow 是母牛；農夫從牠身上取得牛奶，是判斷線索。

cloze_quiz.question: We were lost, so we checked the roads and places on our ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: map 是地圖，可以查看道路和地點；jar、coat、rock 分別是罐子、大衣與岩石。

cloze_quiz.question: The first part of a story is its ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: beginning 是開頭，對應 first part；ending 是結尾，middle 是中間，top 是頂端。

cloze_quiz.question: Dad stood on my left and Mom stood on my right. I was in the ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: 父母分別在左右兩側，所以我在 middle（中間）。

cloze_quiz.question: Fifteen minutes are a ___ of an hour.
cloze_quiz.hint: 一小時有 60 分鐘，15 分鐘是四分之一；quarter 指四分之一，也可指十五分鐘。

cloze_quiz.question: We walked ___ the river, following its bank the whole way.
cloze_quiz.hint: following its bank 表示一路順著河岸走，使用 along（沿著）；across 是橫越，into 是進入，under 是在下方。

cloze_quiz.question: The weather report says the sky will be ___, with no clouds.
cloze_quiz.hint: with no clouds 表示沒有雲；clear 可形容天空晴朗。

cloze_quiz.question: Visitors must ___ through the front gate to enter the farm.
cloze_quiz.hint: pass through 表示通過；遊客要通過大門才能進入農場。

cloze_quiz.question: A ___ is a large area of land covered with many trees.
cloze_quiz.hint: forest 是森林，也就是長滿許多樹的大面積土地。

cloze_quiz.question: After two hours in the sun, the wet towel was completely ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: 毛巾原本是濕的，在太陽下曬兩小時後變乾；dry 是乾燥的。

cloze_quiz.question: There is ___ inside this small jar, but I can't see what it is.
cloze_quiz.hint: 不知道罐子裡是什麼東西時，用 something（某物）；someone／everyone 指人，nowhere 指沒有地方。

cloze_quiz.question: Mom keeps jam in a glass ___ with a lid.
cloze_quiz.hint: jar 是罐子；玻璃材質、有蓋子、可裝果醬，是辨識線索。

cloze_quiz.question: A bird uses its hard mouth, called a ___, to pick up food.
cloze_quiz.hint: beak 是鳥嘴；wing 是翅膀，foot 是腳，tail 是尾巴。

cloze_quiz.question: Stretching my arm is still not enough to ___ the top shelf.
cloze_quiz.hint: reach 可指伸手碰到；手臂伸長仍碰不到最上層架子，是本句意思。arrive 不能直接接 the top shelf 作受詞。

cloze_quiz.question: This hard piece of stone on the ground is a ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: rock 是岩石；hard piece of stone 是線索。

cloze_quiz.question: The bird spread its wings and ___ across the sky.
cloze_quiz.hint: 鳥張開翅膀飛過天空；fly 的過去式是 flew。

cloze_quiz.question: The ball is on the floor. Please ___ the ball and hand it to me.
cloze_quiz.hint: pick up 是撿起；球在地上，要先把它拿起來才能交給對方。

cloze_quiz.question: That is my map. Please give it ___ to me.
cloze_quiz.hint: give it back to me 表示把它還給我；back 在此是回原處、回到原持有人手中。

cloze_quiz.question: Keep the glass jar in your hands. Don't ___ it.
cloze_quiz.hint: 提醒對方把玻璃罐拿穩，不要讓它掉下去；drop 是丟下或落下。

cloze_quiz.question: The frog jumped from outside the box to the inside. It jumped ___ the box.
cloze_quiz.hint: into 表示從外面進到裡面；out of、away from、past 分別是出去、遠離、經過。

cloze_quiz.question: You finished every question correctly! ___
cloze_quiz.hint: 所有題目都答對了，所以要稱讚「做得好！」，使用 Good job!。

cloze_quiz.question: Her son won first place. She has every reason to ___ him.
cloze_quiz.hint: 兒子拿到第一名，母親以他為榮；be proud of 表示以……為榮。

cloze_quiz.question: Walking from the door to the gate and then back to the door is walking ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: 在兩個地方之間往返叫 back and forth（來回地）；up and down 是上下，in a circle 是繞圈，side by side 是並排。

cloze_quiz.question: After many tries, the boy opened the jar at last. In other words, he ___ opened it.
cloze_quiz.hint: at last 表示終於，與 finally 相同；never 是從未，almost 是差一點，usually 是通常。

cloze_quiz.question: The highest part of the mountain is its ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: highest part 是最高處，對應 top（頂端）；bottom 是底部，middle 是中間，side 是側面。

cloze_quiz.question: These old pictures remind Grandma of her ___, especially her childhood.
cloze_quiz.hint: 舊照片讓奶奶想起童年等過往；past 在此作名詞，表示過去。

cloze_quiz.question: Please ___ your homework before you watch TV. Don't leave any questions blank.
cloze_quiz.hint: 不要留下任何空白題，表示要先完成作業；finish 是完成。

cloze_quiz.question: The jar was empty. There was not ___ in it.
cloze_quiz.hint: 空罐子裡沒有任何東西；否定句用 not anything 表示沒有任何事物。

cloze_quiz.question: Please do not ___ in the library. Speak in a quiet voice.
cloze_quiz.hint: 圖書館要小聲說話，所以不要喊叫；shout 是喊叫，whisper 是低聲說話。

cloze_quiz.question: Winning the game filled the children with great ___. They were very happy.
cloze_quiz.hint: 孩子們贏球後非常高興，因此充滿 joy（喜悅）；fear、anger、pain 是害怕、生氣與痛苦。

cloze_quiz.question: The children learned to swim in the school swimming ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: swimming pool 是游泳池，是學習游泳的地方。

cloze_quiz.question: Please call me exactly ___ you arrive, not an hour before or after.
cloze_quiz.hint: exactly 與 not an hour before or after 指定抵達當下，使用 when（當……時）。

cloze_quiz.question: She was too far away to hear me, so I asked her to come ___.
cloze_quiz.hint: 離得太遠聽不到，請她靠近；close 在此作副詞，意思是接近地。
